calculation.description: Ranks recent five-day relative losers more positively, but activates only when observation-only VIX is above its rolling 65th percentile. VIX is used solely as a macro conditioning signal; no order is submitted for it. Inputs are lagged through the previous completed day.

validation.regime_notes: Positive admission statistics are concentrated in the high-VIX regime and occur in 2025-01-01 through 2027-03-24; no active dates occurred in earlier regimes under the 65th-percentile activation rule. Small cross-asset sample requires conservative interpretation.
